evidence.quote: I actually operate entirely as the Zero data retention processor

observations.why: Appeals to data security, privacy retention boundaries, and customer ownership/control as primary values.

evidence.quote: The telephone company always wins because the telephone company sits in between. And it's impossible to disintermediate because they sit in between.

observations.why: Frames strategic defense, durable structural positioning, and un-disintermediatable market advantage as the core good.

evidence.quote: Non commodifiable means you're the telephone company. You sit in between, right? You like literally they can't rip you out without breaking it for somebody else.

observations.why: Extols structural indispensability and protection against commodification as the dominant strategic value.

evidence.quote: Your model will never be never come close because you don't have the history. So you're always going to start at a disadvantage because I'm closer and I'm in it

observations.why: Prizes deep domain craftsmanship, contextual mastery, and self-directed small-scale viability over venture scaling.

evidence.quote: And the v2 backend is really solid. I'm really proud of that work.

observations.why: Expresses pride and value in technical mastery and craft quality.

evidence.quote: how do I find consulting work that retains optionality for me to be able to go and do the Tina thing

observations.why: Appeals directly to retaining personal optionality and self-directed flexibility.

evidence.quote: You are creating a marketplace for as written. So it is not about individual VCs. It is about maximal VCs.

observations.why: Appeals to market dominance, leverage creation, and competitive positioning as the metric of fundraising posture.

mints.title: the telephone company always wins
mints.frame: Does the speaker evaluate strategic position by whether an entity sits indispensably in between counterparties?
